question: The last Shunga ruler was killed by his minister in which century?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1st century BC**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Shunga dynasty was established around **185 BCE** after the fall of the Maurya Empire by Pushyamitra Shunga.
 
• The last ruler of the Shunga dynasty, **Devabhuti**, was assassinated by his minister **Vasudeva Kanva**, marking the end of the dynasty.
 
• This event occurred in the **1st century BC**, around 73 BCE, leading to the rise of the Kanva dynasty.
 
• The Shunga dynasty ruled for nearly 112 years, focusing on the revival of Hinduism and promoting art and culture.
 
• Devabhuti's assassination signified a shift in political power to the Kanvas, who ruled until the Satavahanas took over.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shunga Dynasty:** It succeeded the Maurya Empire and is known for its contributions to Indian art, including the construction of stupas and sculptures at Bharhut and Sanchi.
 
• **Pushyamitra Shunga:** The founder of the Shunga dynasty, who played a key role in reviving Hindu practices after the Mauryan support of Buddhism.
 
• **Kanva Dynasty:** Founded by Vasudeva Kanva, this dynasty replaced the Shungas and ruled central India until the rise of the Satavahana dynasty.
 
• **Devabhuti:** The last Shunga ruler, known for his indulgent lifestyle, which eventually led to his assassination and the decline of the dynasty.
 
• **Political Transition:** The assassination of Devabhuti marked a period of political instability, paving the way for the Kanva dynasty and regional powers like the Satavahanas and Kushanas.
